key_insight: Quantum machine learning models are as vulnerable to adversarial attacks as classical neural networks, necessitating robust verification techniques.
engineering_relevance: The development of VeriQR enables reliable evaluation of quantum adversarial robustness on NISQ hardware.
method: Formulating a fidelity-based robustness lower bound from measurement outcomes.
Utilizing semidefinite programming to compute optimal robustness bounds.
Implementing the findings in the VeriQR tool for practical verification.
evidence_signal: The framework offers both formal verification and empirical estimation of robustness on real quantum devices.
watch_item: Accuracy may vary based on the capabilities of the quantum hardware used for verification.
paper_title: Verifying Adversarial Robustness in Quantum Machine Learning: from theory to physical validation via a software tool
